parameters.name: EndOfJobCreatedTimeRange
parameters.description:
The end of the time range to query jobs by their creation time.

- The date and time are in the ISO 8601 format and in UTC.

- The format is YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ.

parameters.name: JobIds
parameters.description: The ID of the content moderation job. You can obtain the job ID from the response parameters of the [SubmitMediaCensorJob](~~91779~~) operation. Separate multiple IDs with commas (,).

parameters.name: MaximumPageSize
parameters.description:
The maximum number of results to return on each page.

- Default: **30**.

- Valid values: **1 to 300**.

parameters.name: NextPageToken
parameters.description: The token used to retrieve the next page of results. Leave this parameter empty for the first request. The token for the next page is returned in the response to the first request.

parameters.name: PipelineId
parameters.description: The ID of the MPS queue. To obtain the MPS queue ID, log on to the [**ApsaraVideo Media Processing console**](https://mps.console.aliyun.com/overview) and choose **Global Settings** > **MPS Queues and Callbacks**.

parameters.name: StartOfJobCreatedTimeRange
parameters.description:
The start of the time range to query jobs by their creation time.

- The date and time are in the ISO 8601 format and in UTC.

- The format is YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ.

parameters.name: State
parameters.description:
The state of the jobs to query. Valid values:

- **All**: all jobs.

- **Queuing**: jobs that are in the queue.

- **Analysing**: jobs that are being analyzed.

- **Fail**: failed jobs.

- **Success**: successful jobs.
